predictor.notes: Best-supported predictor: three all-units price tiers covering quantities 1–247, 248–618, and 619–1000. Validated at 130 distinct quantities: all 128 estimates match the disclosed band4 rounding of this predictor, and both exact approvals match (50: 191150 pence; 200: 764600 pence). Adjacent probes at 247/248 and 618/619 locate both price drops. Validation included every predicted rounding-bin transition in the latter two tiers and 32 additional gap-filling probes. Conditional on zero-intercept linear pricing within each tier, interval fits constrain the unit rates to approximately [3822.9975, 3823.0025], [1852.8863, 1853.4271], and [785.9394, 786.0133] pence; each interval contains only the reported integer rate. Fixed charges, curvature, and additional tiers are not needed to explain the observations. This is not a uniquely proven exact reconstruction: coarse rounding permits nearby affine or quadratic alternatives, and narrow changes at unsampled quantities cannot be excluded.
